newsitem.title: USA: Micron Custom expands Malaysia facility.
newsitem.headline: Micron Custom expands Malaysia facility.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc's Micron Custom Manufacturing Services Inc said on Monday it expanded the manufacturing and test capacity of its Penang, Malaysia operations by 50 percent, due to demand.
Micron Custom opened its 18,000-square-foot Penang assembly facility in October of 1996.
The facility provides full-service contract manufacturing of board-level products, modules and system- level assemblies to customers in the Asia Pacific Region.
The company said it was expanding the facility because of increased customer demand in Malaysia.
Micron Custom provides custom contract manufacturing services to original equipment manufacturers.
